SAHIL PAGHDAR
Derivatives Trader | Options Trader | Commodity Trader

Surat, Gujarat, India | +91 8488823618 | srppatel805@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Derivatives Trader, Options Trader, and Commodity Trader with 4+ years of experience in equity and commodity

markets. Specializes in cross-asset arbitrage, cash-futures arbitrage, calendar spread arbitrage, short gamma,

and delta-neutral strategies. Consistent monthly returns of 1.5%–2.5% with drawdowns below 4% across NSE,

BSE, MCX, and COMEX markets.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Derivatives Trader & Commodity Trader
Jainam Broking Ltd | December 2023 – Present

• Executed derivatives and commodity trades across NSE, BSE, MCX, and COMEX with consistent

profitability.

• Applied short gamma, delta-neutral, and cross-asset arbitrage strategies with strong Greeks management.

• Identified index-futures arbitrage, calendar spread arbitrage, and statistical arbitrage opportunities.

• Conducted real-time IV analysis, VIX monitoring, and options chain assessment for precise execution.

• Maintained monthly returns of 1.5%–2.5% with maximum drawdown capped at ~4% using ODIN and

GREEKSOFT.

Options Trader
Pace Stock Broking Ltd | December 2022 – November 2023

• Executed straddle, strangle, and spread strategies to capitalize on volatility events.

• Managed risk via disciplined position sizing, stop-loss adherence, and mark-to-market P&L; tracking.

• Identified arbitrage opportunities across index and equity derivatives for low-risk returns.

KEY PERFORMANCE METRICS
• Average Monthly Return: 1.5%–2.5% | Max Drawdown: ~4% | Annual Drawdown: 8%–10%

• Markets: Nifty 50, Bank Nifty, Sensex, MCX (Gold, Silver, Crude Oil), COMEX

CORE SKILLS
• Options Strategies: Straddle, Strangle, Iron Condor, Short Gamma, Delta-Neutral, Bull/Bear Spread

• Arbitrage: Cross-Asset, Cash-Futures, Index-Futures, Calendar Spread, Statistical, Cross-Exchange

Arbitrage

• Commodity Trading: MCX & COMEX – Gold, Silver, Crude Oil, Natural Gas, Base Metals, Copper

• Risk Management: Greeks (Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega), Position Sizing, Drawdown Control, Portfolio

Hedging

• Volatility: Implied Volatility (IV), Historical Volatility, VIX, IV Rank, Skew Analysis, Options Chain

• Markets & Platforms: NSE, BSE, MCX, NCDEX, CME, COMEX | ODIN, GREEKSOFT, NSE NOW

• Trade Execution: High-precision order execution, Intraday & positional trading, Market/Limit/SL orders,

Slippage minimization, Order flow management, Multi-leg options execution

• Financial Services: F&O; Trading, Equity Derivatives, Futures Trading, P&L; Management, Brokerage

Operations

CERTIFICATIONS
• NISM Series VIII – Equity Derivatives



• NISM Series XVI – Commodity Derivatives

EDUCATION

Diploma in Agriculture
Waghai Agriculture College, Navsari Agricultural University, Gujarat
